comments: 70f4c8d9: This MUMPS code is part of the DGJSUM routine, which is used to manage and check the status of discharge summaries in a medical records system.

d9a54d1b: The CHECK function validates the presence and status of a discharge summary for a given patient (DFN), date (DGJTDT), and other parameters. It sets flags based on the presence or absence of the summary, ensuring compliance with division parameters.
e80b5266: Initialize the local variable DGJOUT which will be used to indicate an early exit from the loop if a condition is met.
aee77029: Retrieve division parameters for the discharge summary from the DG (Division Globals) namespace, using the division ID provided in DGJT("DIV").
7d4752d2: Exit the function early if division parameters are not found or are not set.
e0cd6ac8: Set the default discharge summary type if DGJTYP is not already defined, using the first entry in the 'B' index of the VAS(393.3) file that matches 'DISCHARGE SUMMARY'.

33897e25: Check if the specified IRT record exists and whether it has a date/time; set DGJFLG to 1 to indicate this state and exit if so. This ensures we do not proceed with records that are missing required date/time entries.
5446a70f: Exit the loop early if the specified IRT record already exists, indicating no need to add a new record.

7b552386: Iterate through the 'B' index of the VAS(393) file for the given DFN, setting DGJIRTDA to the internal record number (IRN) of each entry found until all are checked or an early exit condition is met.
993c1182: Check if the record matches the required discharge summary type and admission number; if so, set DGJOUT to 1 to indicate a matching record has been found and exit the loop.
79eea9f6: If no matching IRT record is found, call the ADD function to create a new one.
4fd1a771: Exit the function.
